TermTranslation.definition: A drug that stops pain, fever and inflammation.
A measurement used to tell if people are underweight, overweight, obese or in the normal weight range for their height.
The longest part of the large intestine.
The part of fruit, vegetables, beans and grains that the body cannot break down but that helps the body move and digest food.
When the lining of the intestines becomes inflamed, the intestinal walls become swollen and ulcers develop.
